rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something fake, false, or not genuine.

example.english: This claim is spurious, so don't believe it.
example.traditional: 呢個講法係假嘅，唔好信。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 gong2 faat3 hai6 gaa2 ge3 m4 hou2 seon3

rows.note: Use this when the thing is unwanted, extraneous, or getting in the way rather than fake.

example.traditional: 你加呢句落去就多餘喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 gaa1 ne1 geoi3 lok6 heoi3 zau6 do1 jyu4 laa3
